# Templates

29 registered templates, one per question. A template declares raw engine keywords over a module wrapper; `fill` sets the inputs and `run` solves it. The wrappers are in [`../modules.md`](../modules.md).

## [`artemis`](artemis.md)

Build an ARTEMIS phase-resolving wave model from scratch.

Module `artemis`.

## [`artemis_harbor_agitation`](artemis_harbor_agitation.md)

The WAVE AGITATION (Kd = Hs/H0) inside a harbour, marina or basin, behind a declared structure or free-field.

Module `artemis`.

## [`geoclaw`](geoclaw.md)

Build a GeoClaw model from scratch.

Module `geoclaw`.

## [`geoclaw_storm_surge`](geoclaw_storm_surge.md)

STORM SURGE from a real hurricane across the sea to a coast - the water height the storm's wind and low pressure raise, how far inland and how deep it floods, and the water level at a gauge.

Module `geoclaw`.

## [`geoclaw_tsunami_inundation`](geoclaw_tsunami_inundation.md)

A TSUNAMI from a sea-floor rupture across the open sea to a coast, and how far inland and how deep it floods, with the wave's arrival time and the water level at a gauge.

Module `geoclaw`.
